methods.name: Digital processing techniques (PCA, ICA) and automated change detection
methods.summary: The authors used Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Independent Component Analysis (ICA), and the DeltaCue Site monitoring tool within Erdas Imagine software to process optical imagery for landslide mapping, alongside interferometric processing of Sentinel-1 radar data.
methods.verbatim: their processing took place through the use of digital processing techniques (PCA, ICA) and also automated change detection procedure in Erdas Imagine software.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the method's code is not available.
